eq.follow: Partial execution: opted-in public self NPCs follow the initiating live player through durable relationship controls and existing server path clocks. Default10units and source run threshold, retained guard, no waypoint events, transactional retries/held stop and rendered two-destination observer check are verified. Source replacement, unavailable-player lookup, invalid-route retry and idle clock-count checks pass SQL; actual Zrelik Orders/follow/troop-command integration passes rendered two-client review. Separate transport death/disconnect tests, private actors, other players, NPC targets and native patrol interruption remain incomplete.
eq.stop_follow: Partial execution: public self follow controls revoke the relationship and freeze the controller-owned leg after combat ownership releases, without waypoint arrival. SQL held-stop and rendered stop-then-player-movement checks pass; broader lifecycle and private/NPC following remain incomplete.
eq.start: Partial execution: owner-scoped circular (0), patrol (3) and one-way depop/respawn (6/4) routes use saved per-step progress, sampled pauses and client arrival receipts. Personal and static actor callbacks settle atomically under a live actor reservation. Authored respawn at type4 terminal arrival shares the existing atomic removal/deadline transaction; rollback and replay are covered. Random destinations, public-world respawn grids, arbitrary mixed batches and complete escort encounters remain unsupported or unverified.
eq.stop: Partial execution: an actor can stop its own route from a correlated server waypoint callback after the preceding move has committed. Stops from arbitrary dialogue/timers, mid-move cancellation and unrelated actor stops remain unsupported.
eq.move_to: Quest movement requests are not connected to NPC navigation.
e.self:MoveTo: Partial execution: persisted routed walks for distinct scoped actors run independently with per-actor ordering and durable arrival receipts. Version-4 scenes observe hostile NPC contacts during an issued walk through scoped faction/range/visibility checks and idempotent hate delivery. Combat may interrupt the walk and the client resumes it afterward; Version-5 scenes support NPC spell lists and melee procs against NPC opponents; passive spell-effect lists and list-level ranged/defensive procs remain rejected. Repeated destinations for the same actor in one batch, mixed movement/hate/attack/signal batches, and actor-depop combinations remain unsupported. Single walks now dispatch supported arrival/departure handlers once through the same durable route cursor, including callback-issued next walks and SetRunning immediately before MoveTo. Static actors use a lifetime reservation. No-grid callbacks use EQEmu arrival -2/departure 0; an interrupted grid uses -1. Ordinary patrol resumption after an interrupted grid is not proven by the Icefang test. Public world-actor self and scoped foreign MoveTo now use the same finite cursor and server path clock: one arrival, no loop/depop, shared restoration, SaveGuardSpot preservation and combat-hold/resume. Finite public walks may be replaced atomically; distinct scoped public walk batches preflight all routes and fence original caller/recipient lifetimes in one transaction. Real troop-order UI, two-client poses and separate rendered re-entry are verified; the amended combined screenshot assertion is not rerun. Assigned-patrol interruption, combat-held replacement, basic public stationary/moving source contact admission and natural NPC melee/death are now integrated through shared contact/hate delivery. Public moving/held contact, off-mesh archers/ranged combat and full war remain unverified; initiating-player following and real scout orders are separately verified. Private/NPC-target following remains incomplete.

e.self:SetRunning: Partial execution: one persisted patrol-speed change or a speed change immediately before a supported grid start or single MoveTo is implemented. Trusted public self waypoint callbacks can change future route speed transactionally with the same callback receipt and single successor; current clocks remain immutable. The server publishes the run/walk animation flag. Uncorrelated public timer/signal speed changes, personal continuing-grid callback speed changes, foreign SetRunning and arbitrary mixed movement/hate batches remain unsupported.
